method: Visual silhouette estimates using view_image at original 1536x1024 resolution. Bounding boxes include the visible main building, roof, ornament/lantern and foundation steps, excluding trees, cast shadows, people and detached buildings. Measurements are approximate, not pixel segmentation. Origin top-left; bbox=[left,top,right,bottom].
